basic_info.description:
This recently remodeled and modernized 2 Bedroom, 1 bath flat, in the heart of the revitalized Inner Mission District combines the sleek minimalist lines of a recently designed and executed remodel, while remaining consistent and true to the architectural and period details of this wonderfully rendered property. Located steps from a thriving dining and social scene, and three blocks from the last Technology Shuttle Stop before the Freeway entrance, this beautifully re-imagined Single Family home personifies a perfect balance between old world charm and modern technology and convenience.

Spread over an efficiently laid out 1,100 square foot floor plan, the home packs an abundance of utility and charisma. The home basks in natural light and exudes an air of lightness that is found throughout the entirety of this wonderfully designed Remodeled Charmer.

The home provides a seamless transition between urban, social proximity, and professional, logistical convenience. The neighborhood provides a lifestyle and level of convenience that are virtually unparalleled in the City and County of San Francisco.

Key Terms:

- Available June 1, 2021
- Terms between 12 and 24 Months Considered
- Offered in an Unfurnished Capacity
- Garbage Included
- Large Storage Space Included

Key Features:

- 2 Bedrooms, 1 Bath
- 150 sq. foot Storage Space
- Manicured Backyard Space
- Abundant Light
- Steps from Transit and Tech Shuttles
- Proximity to Thriving Culinary and Social Scene
